levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري

notes: «وَ عَنْهُ» at the opening refers back to prev1: the name taken over is the first name of prev1's chain (the one who says «حدثني» there), so it is inherited from prev1
«عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ (ع)» is rule 7 (kin with a name: the name alone); an Imam written after «عن» stays a narrator (owner ruling 2), and he relays the Prophet's action
«- ابن» and «رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ» style blessings are left out
